text: These are photos of my café: the storefront pic, the latte pic and the pastries pic. Make a cosy 9-second vertical Instagram reel using all three, storefront first. Gentle movement, soft upbeat music, no talking. Put “Maple Street Café” at the start and “Your morning starts here” at the end. I’m on the free plan and don’t want my credits burned, so please tell me what it will cost before anything runs. Is there a cheaper, shorter or smaller way to do it?
